prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full playable level-map concept for Snabbit, Pack 4 level 2.
Primary request: Design ONE beautiful small upward journey through two distinct arrangements of pale chunky asteroid blocks, with exactly two chunky lever switches and three yellow stars. This must be a fresh authored game LEVEL MAP, not poster art, on a dark navy background.
Input images: Image 1 source game sprite sheet is the authoritative material and object style, particularly the real squat heavy lever. Images 2, 3, 4 show actual earlier pack opening maps and are references for irregular landform silhouettes, loose natural clustering and generous negative space; do not copy a whole level or their geometric repeating examples.
Composition/framing: tall portrait full-map view, bottom-to-top travel. Approximately 16 staggered columns by 64 rows. Begin with empty space at bottom, the green snake at bottom slightly right of center. The lower arrangement is an irregular offset island built of individually visible faceted white/gray block sprites, with a diagonal navigable breach through one shoulder. It is asymmetric, lumpy, with varied edge lengths, tiny holes and a few detached chips; it must NOT be a crescent. An accessible chunky lever near its right shore opens a little local notch to the first star. The middle third is an open calm courtyard with a second star off to the right and only a few loose pebbles; a player can choose different sweeping routes through this space. The upper arrangement is a loose offset group of two uneven islands that almost meet, framing a surprising open courtyard and a sheltered final star, rather than a symmetrical ring. The second chunky lever sits on the accessible lower-left shore of that upper arrangement and opens a short breach toward the sheltered last star. End with a small loose sparkle goal near the top, not a cross-map finish bar.
Style/medium: clean orthographic 2D game map using actual faceted low-poly original sprite materials. Crisp separated small stones seated on offset-hex cells, cyan gems sparingly dotted in small curved groups of two or three, with wide breathing space. Both arrangements must look visually different and hand composed.
Constraints: upward-only movement, left/right steering and horizontal wrap. All routes and spaces belong to one 16-column playfield. EXACTLY 2 visible lever objects, EXACTLY 3 yellow stars, no labels, no UI panels, no numbers, no grid lines, no drawn route.
Avoid: repeated full-width obstacle rows, corridors bordered by straight rail walls, repeated zigzag tracks, concentric crescents, symmetrical geometric diamonds, dense blue gem rails, a large illustrative meteor backdrop, furniture, buildings, photorealism, any decorative obstacle outside the actual playfield.
